metadata.focus: English presentation graph for Stream <-> Elixir transfers, Stream self-mint evidence, and the Plume Morpho xUSD/USDC private lending market

findings.message: Direct token transfers between Stream observed actors and Elixir observed actors are present in the selected block window.
Stream-controlled actors sent USDC/USDT into the xUSD mint surface and xUSD was minted back to Stream-controlled actors in the same scan window.
Stream-controlled actor posted sdeUSD collateral and borrowed USDC from the Morpho sdeUSD/USDC market; current Morpho snapshot shows a large remaining USDC borrow.
A MetaMorpho vault whose onchain name is MEV Capital Elixir USDC is the current top supplier in the Morpho deUSD/USDC market.
On Plume, an Elixir-linked Safe supplied almost all USDC into a Morpho xUSD/USDC market, while the Stream actor posted xUSD and borrowed almost all USDC.
Stream actor bridged xUSD from Ethereum to Plume via LayerZero OFT before posting it as Plume Morpho collateral.
